falsifier: the closing adds confirmed findings, or open facts grow as fast as needs-info findings
hypothesis: the STRIDE lane closing adds only needs-info findings, and the open facts a reader must answer grow more slowly than the findings do
intervention: read the STRIDE block of each report for cases 02, 05 and 10 in sweep B stage 1 (no closing) and in the E5 run (closing), and grouped each with analysis_service.open_facts. Needs-info 38 -> 78, confirmed 6 -> 6, open facts 28 -> 44 (0.74 -> 0.56 facts a finding). Over all 13 tuned cases of stage 1, 175 of 200 findings are needs-info, on 129 open facts
reconsider_when: the vote ballot on the closing's added findings (#1239 item 3) returns, or a full sweep with the closing runs
scope: one run per arm, three tuned cases, STRIDE; counts only, no reader judged whether the added findings are worth reading
signature: the lane closing adds conditional findings, and a reader has more open facts to answer

falsifier: the share settled by six greedy questions does not fall between the stage 1 and closing reports
hypothesis: with the lane closing, the six-question cap #1225 recommended settles a smaller share of a report's needs-info findings
intervention: ranked each report's open facts greedily from its own verdicts (the ranking #1225 recommends) and counted the needs-info findings 3, 6 and 10 questions settle. Stage 1: 20, 29, 36 of 38 (six settle 76%). Closing: 29, 49, 64 of 78 (six settle 63%, ten settle 82%)
reconsider_when: #1225 is built, or the lane closing changes
scope: three tuned cases, one run per arm, STRIDE; the greedy ranking reads the report it asks about, so this is an upper bound for a cap of that size, and it assumes each answer settles its fact
signature: a report asks a submitter more open facts than an intake cap can settle
